resolvedFinding.baselineEvidence: At baseline, ERPConsoleClient.execute serialized every command input into ERPPendingCommand before dispatch, including currentPassword/newPassword/secret/otp. ERPPendingCommand.validate checked envelope integrity but not credential content. Generic action fields used TextField, and ERPCommandInput trimmed every string. This was verified from baseline/current diffs, not represented as an executed prior native exploit.
resolvedFinding.impact: User-entered password/MFA values could enter the encrypted durable recovery file and be retained for replay; generic forms also displayed credential values as ordinary text. The journal was encrypted, not a plaintext disk file.
resolvedFinding.correction: Only the two reviewed credential commands take the bounded one-shot path. They never construct or insert a journal record; regular payloads and loaded legacy envelopes reject recognized secret keys recursively. Fields are masked, password bytes remain exact, and every dispatched outcome ends only the captured local session with a reauthentication/check message.

sourceConclusions.classificationAndValidation: The one-shot allowlist uses full exact names and requires identity.self metadata. Allowed input keys/types are exact: password rotation has currentPassword/newPassword; MFA has currentPassword/secret/otp. Password limits use UTF-16 code units to match JS/Android bounds, and MFA regex matches must cover the whole string. Unrelated secret-shaped nested keys fail closed before journal insertion or POST.
sourceConclusions.freshAuthority: An accepted /me response stores a canonical complete raw actor snapshot, including future fields. Only reporting-only mfaVerifiedAt is excluded; known role/permission/site/warehouse/customer arrays are sorted. Immediately before the one-shot POST, refresh revalidates same user/company/origin/session and compares the fresh actor snapshot. Drift resets that captured session before any POST.
sourceConclusions.staleCompletion: send checks its captured generation both after a thrown transport result and before interpreting HTTP status, so an old 401 cannot reset a newer session. executeCredential then require(current) checks generation/origin/user/company. Its reset defer additionally matches captured generation/origin and cannot clear a newer login. The model checks its own ticket before clearing presentation; credential completion uses synchronous clearSessionPresentation without issuing another logout.
sourceConclusions.persistenceAndRetry: The one-shot branch occurs before ERPPendingCommand construction/insert, uses one in-memory UUID key, and does not retain a recovery envelope. Success requires 200/201 plus ok:true and reauthenticationRequired:true; all uncertain dispatched failures become fixed reauthentication/unknown-outcome errors, with no auto retry or saved explicit replay. Existing unresolved regular requests block credentials and remain unchanged.
sourceConclusions.legacyDurableSafety: validatedPending invokes validate even for custom stores. Encrypted load validates decrypted records. One-shot command names or recursively recognized secret-shaped input fail with pendingStorage before replay. Old unsafe encrypted files are retained, not silently overwritten/deleted. The ordinary compare-and-swap resolve, actor/origin ownership checks and existing durable transmit/retry behavior are preserved.
sourceConclusions.inputAndUI: Credential defaults from server schema are skipped. Sensitive string values preserve leading/trailing whitespace; ordinary values retain prior trimming. SecureField is used with password/newPassword/oneTimeCode traits and no password Autofill trait for MFA seed. Draft secrets are removed synchronously before asynchronous submit and on session change/disappearance. Unsupported credential actions show safe account-settings guidance. Record detail suppresses recognized secret field names; nested objects were already not rendered as raw content.
sourceConclusions.errorsAndLogging: New one-shot errors contain fixed generic guidance and do not propagate raw server error codes/response bodies into user text. Localized HTTP formatting keeps only status. Reviewed changes introduce no credential logging, UserDefaults writes, persistent HTTP cache or new durable secret store.
sourceConclusions.compatibility: Existing HTTPS/same-origin/no-redirect, cookie/CSRF, 15s request and 30s resource timeouts, model epoch/captured authority and durable recovery safeguards remain. Worker/GPS API, tracker, secure storage and branded shared presentation files are byte-identical to baseline. The root vehicleTrips localization entry remains present.
